title: Induction Machine Scalar Control
text: Induction machine V/f control, 1 input, 1 output; {Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency, {Rated voltage (V)} sets the voltage, {Minimum voltage (V)} sets the voltage and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rated voltage (V)
params.values: Voltage 550 (default) | positive and greater than the value of the Minimum voltage (V) parameter
